label: 2 — Interactive Code Generation (iter 1, cold)
summary: Cold codegen of the LRE controller from requirement_all.json: 15 Java files (annotation, mode, constants, event, sensor, actuator, operation, controller). All 51 requirement IDs traced in result_codegen.json. Seven items below need user review.

issues.title: cstc/cdyn typed as plain int, not @RoboChartType("nat")
issues.detail: LRE-Var5/Var6 call them natural numbers, but the -1 'no obstacle' sentinel is not a nat. Declared as signed int (default RoboChart int mapping), matching the hand-maintained csp_overrides.csp core_int = {-1..1}.

issues.title: Sensor safe large distance = 1.0e6
issues.detail: LRE-DM5 mandates a 'safe large distance' when no obstacle exists but gives no value. Used 1000000.0 (NO_OBSTACLE_DIST), comfortably above every threshold (all 1.0).

issues.title: CalcCPA: obstacle velocities treated as relative; CPA in horizontal plane
issues.detail: LRE-OP5 says CalcCPA 'accesses the obstacle's relative position and velocity'. Obstacle obs_ns_vel/obs_ew_vel are treated as already-relative velocities; CPA uses the 2-D horizontal plane (obs_depth/obs_roc unused). tcpa = -(r.v)/|v|^2, cda = |r + v*tcpa|.

issues.title: CalcCPA division by zero when no dynamic obstacle exists
issues.detail: Sensor returns zero-velocity defaults (per LRE-OP5), so closingSpeedSq = 0 and tcpa/cda evaluate to NaN in Java. NaN makes cdaBelowMinSafe and tcpaNonNegative false (no spurious CAM entry) and !cdaBelowMinSafe true (CAM exits to OCM when no dynamic obstacle) — safe behaviour, but the verifiers may flag the division; revisit if Dafny complains.

issues.title: Velocity thresholds are literal 1.0
issues.detail: LRE-Beh4/9/11 compare vel/hvel/vvel against 1 m/s; LreConstants defines only distance thresholds, so the velocity comparisons use the literal 1.0. Distance guards in LRE-Beh4 ('greater than 1') use MIN_SAFE_DIST (default 1).

issues.title: CAM has no entry action
issues.detail: LRE-FR4 says CAM 'performs evasive manoeuvres' but no concrete advVel/advHdng output is specified, and LRE-DM7 limits outputs to advVel/advHdng. No entry action emitted for CAM.

issues.title: Inner-branch priority: operator events > inOpez > CAM > HCM; opVel/opHdng payload fields added
issues.detail: The spec gives no relative priority among MOM's autonomous transitions; ordered as operator overrides, exclusion zone, collision avoidance, then the three HCM guards (Beh9, Beh10, Beh11). OCM pass-through captures reqVel/reqHdng payloads into controller fields opVel/opHdng (typed-trigger pattern); these two fields are not in the LRE-Var list.

next_step: Run the deterministic pipeline (compile through vacuity) and iterate from post_* feedback.
